notesAndCredits:
Liquid Glass Renderer V2

Almost not functional on Scratch
Try with TurboWarp:
https://turbowarp.org/1406787990?hqpen

Click the green flag to start. Drag any glass shape to stretch it, or bring two shapes close together to see them connect.

How to use:
1 / 2 / 3: Change the main shape to a rounded rectangle, capsule, or circle.
Space: Expand or collapse the main shape.
M: Start or stop the circle moving automatically.
P: Start or stop the pull demo to see all three shapes stretch.
E: Show or hide the effect sliders.
B: Switch between the photo background and the test grid.
Q: Cycle rendering quality. Lower detail runs faster.
R: Reset the shapes and effect settings to their defaults.

Current Version: 0.7.4
Last Updated: Nov 6, 2026
